source_caption: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982) is a beloved sci-fi adventure about a gentle alien stranded on Earth who befriends a lonely boy named Elliott. As Elliott and his siblings try to hide E.T. from government agents, they work together to help the alien contact his home and return to his planet. Directed by Steven Spielberg and starring Henry Thomas, the film became one of the most iconic family movies ever made, known for its emotional story about friendship and belonging.

source_details.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
source_details.synopsis: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (or simply E.T.) is a 1982 American science fantasy film produced and directed by Steven Spielberg and written by Melissa Mathison. It tells the story of Elliott, a boy who befriends an extraterrestrial that he names E.T. who has been stranded on Earth. Along with his friends and family, Elliott must find a way to help E.T. find his way home. The film stars Dee Wallace, Henry Thomas, Peter Coyote, Robert MacNaughton, and Drew Barrymore. The film's concept was based on an imaginary friend that Spielberg created after his parents' divorce.
